name: Hiking
description: Day hikes from easy nature walks to all-day summit pushes.

name: Backpacking
description: Multi-day trips into wilderness. Most parks require a wilderness permit.

name: Camping
description: Front-country campgrounds, RV sites and group sites.

name: Kayaking & Canoeing
description: Flatwater lakes, sea kayaking and river paddling.

name: Whitewater Rafting
description: Guided and private river trips. River flow is the key condition.

name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding
description: Calm lakes and protected coves.

name: Boating
description: Motorboats, sailing and boat tours. Check launch ramps and invasive-species inspection rules.

name: Fishing
description: Fly fishing streams, lakes and saltwater flats. State licenses usually apply.

name: Rock Climbing
description: Trad, sport and bouldering. Watch for seasonal raptor-nesting closures.

name: Mountaineering
description: Alpine routes, glacier travel and high peaks.

name: Skiing & Riding
description: Backcountry ski touring and splitboarding. Avalanche forecasts are essential.

name: Cross-Country Skiing
description: Groomed and ungroomed Nordic trails.

name: Snowshoeing
description: Winter walks and ranger-led snowshoe programs.

name: Ice Climbing
description: Frozen waterfalls and alpine ice.

name: Biking
description: Paved park roads and designated bike trails. Bikes are not allowed on most park trails.

name: Horseback Riding
description: Stock-friendly trails and guided trail rides.

name: Swimming
description: Designated swim areas. Rivers can be deadly during snowmelt.

name: Snorkeling & Diving
description: Reefs, kelp forests and clear lakes.

name: Caving
description: Ranger-led cave tours and permitted wild caving.

name: Wildlife Watching
description: Best at dawn and dusk. Keep 25 yards from most wildlife, 100 from bears and wolves.

name: Stargazing
description: Dark-sky viewing and night-sky programs.

name: Scenic Driving
description: Park roads and overlooks. Check alerts for road closures and timed-entry reservations.

name: Photography
description: Golden hour, astrophotography and webcams to scout conditions.
